live_client_initialization.service_exception: Your default credentials were not found. To set up Application Default Credentials, see https://cloud.google.com/docs/authentication/external/set-up-adc for more information.

sandbox_evaluation.sandbox_concept: Google Cloud BigQuery Sandbox provides no-cost exploration without a billing account.
sandbox_evaluation.sandbox_authentication_requirement: CRITICAL: BigQuery Sandbox DOES NOT permit anonymous, unauthenticated API calls. Even in Sandbox mode, all requests to bigquery.googleapis.com require an authenticated Google Cloud Project identifier and OAuth 2.0 / ADC bearer tokens. Without local ADC or service credentials, the BigQuery API client cannot initialize or execute queries.
sandbox_evaluation.quota_overage_behavior: Queries exceeding 1 TiB/month are blocked with quota errors rather than billed.

exact_blocker_summary: Authentication failed via google.auth.exceptions.DefaultCredentialsError. Neither local ADC credentials (gcloud auth application-default login), nor GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS, nor an authenticated Google Cloud Project ID are present. Because BigQuery Sandbox also enforces authenticated identity, live service query validation cannot be completed without user-provided credentials.
